name: 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup
tagline: MW2 (2009), Minecraft and Skate 3 in one Rust game: MW2 maps with bots, an endless Minecraft world fought with MW2 guns, and skating on any map.

games.label: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009)
games.engine: IW4L (Rust rewrite of the IW4 engine) reading MW2's fastfiles in place
games.runtime: PC multiplayer (iw4mp.exe and zone/), tested with the Steam version
games.mode: bots, LAN or IW4L's own servers; never MW2's official multiplayer

games.label: Minecraft
games.uses: client.jar and assets downloaded from Mojang on first run (about 125 MB)

games.label: Skate 3 (Xbox 360, optional)
games.uses: your own extracted copy (default.xex + data/), converted on your PC; skating needs a controller

requires.note: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) with multiplayer installed (the folder with iw4mp.exe and zone/); IW4L only reads it
own Minecraft: Java Edition; the game downloads 26.3's files from Mojang itself on first run
your own Skate 3 disc or Games on Demand copy, extracted (extract-xiso or Velocity): default.xex with its data folder; ISO files are refused
an Xbox controller, needed to skate

notes: How it works: one new Rust game (IW4L) plays Modern Warfare 2 (2009) multiplayer maps with bots, an endless Minecraft world you fight through with MW2 guns, and Skate 3 skating on any map. It reads your MW2 files and never changes them.

To start: open this mashup's folder (Open folder in the app) and run iw4l.exe; the Play button cannot start it yet. First run: confirm your MW2 folder, answer Yes and pick Skate 3's default.xex, or No to play without skating. It downloads Minecraft 26.3's files from Mojang (about 125 MB) once.

Minecraft map: Create Game > MINECRAFT tab > overworld (or run "Minecraft World.bat"). E inventory, 1-9 hotbar, Q drop, left click mine, right click place, ` console. J or clicking both sticks toggles skating (controller needed to skate).

You need MW2 (2009) on PC with multiplayer installed (the folder with iw4mp.exe and zone/; tested with Steam), Windows 64-bit, and internet on the first run. Optional: your own Skate 3 for Xbox 360, extracted (extract-xiso or Velocity; an .iso is refused), and an Xbox controller.

Offline with bots, LAN or IW4L's own servers only: it never connects to MW2's official multiplayer, Steam or VAC. Start over: delete .env next to iw4l.exe. Restore deletes the whole folder, including the Minecraft files and skate-data.
Beta with open bugs (invisible skateboard on some maps, missing killcams, skate markers): report bugs to the authors with the Report a bug link.
